title: Implement planner-web/load/stop agent tools in pi-adapter
summary: Register planner-web, planner-load, planner-stop agent tools wrapping the internal web/enabled helpers.
description:
Register planner-web, planner-load, and planner-stop as agent tools in the pi-adapter, wrapping the internal functions used by the slash commands.

## Current state
- pi-adapter registers data CRUD tools via pi.registerTool (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:2328+).
- Web/load/stop exist only as slash command handlers (lines 1094-1105, 3555) calling internal startServer/stopServer/getWebStatus/buildStartupResumeSummary.

## Work items
- planner-web tool: input { action: 'start' | 'stop' | 'status' }.
  - start → startServer({ host: '0.0.0.0', port: 0 }) → return { localUrl, lanUrl, port, running: true }.
  - stop → stopServer() → return { running: false }.
  - status → getWebStatus() → return { running, localUrl, lanUrl, port }.
- planner-load tool: no required input → enable planner (set enabled flag), startServer(LAN), build recap (project status + handoff if present + Web UI address) → return recap text + web URL. Matches /planner load slash behavior.
- planner-stop tool (alias planner-disable): no input → stopServer() + disable planner flag → return { disabled: true, webRunning: false }.
- All three tool descriptions must note: planner ops are NOT code edits; web does NOT auto-start; LAN-bound.
- Reuse existing internal helpers; do NOT duplicate logic.

## Behaviors to preserve
- D4 disabled by default; D5 load/stop semantics; D6 URL only in tool response/recap; D10 composite IDs.

## Code references
- packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:2328+ (registerTool pattern), 1094-1105 & 3555 (slash handlers + helpers), 788 (startServer port-busy handling), 3484-3495 (buildStartupResumeSummary for recap).
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts (planner-web/load/stop MCP definitions to mirror for parity).
